chapter_level_claim: ODSP extends ecological prediction from a single collapsed suitability or support value to a probability distribution over declared ecological states, then asks whether the additional state resolution improves prediction in independent groups. Known-truth benchmarks recover stable, null and shifted predictive regimes; prospectively frozen public-data endpoints show both structural unavailability and strong but heterogeneous cross-individual state prediction.

supported: empirical evidence that state resolution can add predictive information for many held-out individuals
